tasks.title: Vendor Pulse backend + contract
tasks.objective: Vendor Pulse's backend and contract into the repo (stripping MBS specifics) and set up the npm workspace so backend and contract build and typecheck.
tasks.reviewer_focus: Clean vendor: no MBS domain/seed references remain (operations, leadActivity, MBS grants); minimal workspace wiring; no dead code; contract types compile and are the single source of shared types.
acceptance_criteria: backend and contract build and typecheck in the npm workspace
MBS-specific domains (operations, leadActivity) and MBS seeds/grants are removed
npm install succeeds at repo root with workspaces contract/backend

plan_contracts.statement: backend and contract build and typecheck in the npm workspace
MBS-specific domains (operations, leadActivity) and MBS seeds/grants are removed
npm install succeeds at repo root with workspaces contract/backend

review_budget.reason: Vendored Pulse backend+contract snapshot per decision 0008 — bulk import of our own code, reviewed as Pulse @ commit (not authored line-by-line); the MBS-strip and workspace-wiring deltas are the reviewable authored surface.

tasks.title: Postgres warehouse adapter
tasks.objective: Implement a Postgres adapter behind the Warehouse port, add a separate warehouse Postgres, and flip the SQL validator dialect to postgresql so a trivial query runs end-to-end.
acceptance_criteria: PostgresAdapter implements the Warehouse port and is selected via warehouseDriver=postgres
the SQL validator uses the postgresql dialect
a trivial query runs end-to-end against a separate warehouse Postgres defined in docker-compose

tasks.title: Backend boots + OTP auth on Postgres
tasks.objective: Trim migrations to the auth+audit minimum, run them, and boot the backend so email+OTP login works with RBAC and audit intact.
acceptance_criteria: app-DB migrations trimmed to auth+audit run cleanly
the backend boots and email+OTP login works (mock OTP)
RBAC and append-only audit are intact; boot/login smoke tests pass

tasks.title: Fresh frontend shell + OTP login
tasks.objective: Build a fresh Next.js frontend (shadcn/ui + Tailwind, themed by the KnackLabs _ds tokens) with the app shell and OTP login per the approved Claude Design, consuming the backend API.
acceptance_criteria: the Next.js app builds and the app shell (top bar + left nav) renders in KnackLabs green, branded 3F
the OTP login screen works against the backend
components use shadcn/ui + Tailwind themed by the _ds tokens, faithful to the Claude Design

tasks.title: Harness build/verify wiring
tasks.objective: Wire harness.yaml build/verify/test/lint to the workspace scripts so verify.py and the gates run against the vendored app, keeping dual-runtime and vendor integrity clean.
acceptance_criteria: harness.yaml build/verify/test/lint point at the workspace scripts
verify.py runs green against the app
dual-runtime check and vendor integrity are clean
